posts.title: How Tabletist is built: a native database client in Rust and egui
posts.description: Tabletist is a database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite and BigQuery. It is written in Rust on egui, and it runs on Linux, macOS and Windows. This post is about how it is built: the rules the compiler holds for me, the rules tests hold by reading the source, how I test a GUI without a screen, and where the code is still only as good as review. Everything quoted here is real code from the repo

posts.title: Docker Captain of the Year 🐳
posts.description: I’m thrilled and honored to share that I’ve been recognized by Docker as Docker Captain of the Year! This came as a complete surprise. I had no idea I was even nominated, and being selected is beyond anything I could have imagined. I want to thank Docker and the amazing community. You are the reason I keep pushing forward, keep learning, and keep working to make our ecosystem better for everyone.
